name: SMACS J2332.4-5358 (Hubble)
blurb: SMACS J2332.4-5358, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: smacsj2332-hubble
story: A massive crowd of galaxies from Hubble's snapshot survey of the most massive clusters, systems whose gravity can act as a lens on the galaxies far behind them.

claims.text: SMACS J2332.4-5358 was a target of a snapshot survey of the most massive galaxy clusters
The survey's clusters are highly efficient gravitational lenses
SMACS is the southern extension of the X-ray-selected MACS survey of massive clusters
